name: viralhunt-mcp
description: MCP server for ViralHunt.io: find trending/viral content across TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook, Pinterest, Bluesky, Douyin, Reddit, Mastodon, Tumblr, Hacker News and news RSS; search one keyword on every network; learn the best time to post, top hashtags, trending sounds and the best communities; make on-brand images from the organization's templates; leave complete posts as drafts, review them, translate them into a linked project's language; and publish, schedule or edit posts on your connected social accounts.
author: ViralHunt (https://viralhunt.io)
